en: Section B interview.
zh: B节：访谈。

en: In this section, you will hear one interview.
zh: 在这一节中，你将听到一段访谈。

en: The interview will be divided into two parts.
zh: 这段访谈分为两部分。

en: At the end of each part, five questions will be asked about what was said.
zh: 每部分结束后，将就刚才所说的内容提出五个问题。

en: Both the interview and the questions will be spoken once only.
zh: 访谈和问题都只读一遍。

en: After each question, there will be a ten-second pause.
zh: 每个问题之后会有十秒钟的停顿。

en: During the pause, you should read the four choices of A, B, C, and D and mark the best answer to each question on answer sheet two.
zh: 请利用停顿时间阅读A、B、C、D四个选项，并在答题卡二上标出每题的最佳答案。

en: You have thirty seconds to preview the questions.
zh: 你有三十秒钟预览题目。

en: Listen to Part 1 of the interview.
zh: 现在请听访谈的第一部分。

en: Questions 1 to 5 are based on Part 1 of the interview.
zh: 第1至5题根据访谈的第一部分提问。

en: Now listen to the interview between Oscar-winning actress Angelina Jolie and CNN's Arwa Damon.
zh: 现在请听奥斯卡获奖演员安吉丽娜·朱莉与CNN记者阿尔瓦·达蒙的访谈。

en: First of all thank you obviously for your time, Angelina.
zh: 首先，安吉丽娜，谢谢您抽时间接受采访。

en: You are now in Iraq. So what is your main aim in this visit?
zh: 您现在人在伊拉克。那么，这次访问的主要目的是什么？

en: What are you trying to accomplish while you are out here?
zh: 来到这里，您希望达成什么目标？

en: Well I came to the region about 6 months ago.
zh: 大约六个月前，我曾经来过这个地区。

en: I first went to Syria because I work with U.N.H.C.R. and there are 1.5 million refugees in Syria alone from Iraq
zh: 我先去了叙利亚，因为我与联合国难民署合作，而仅在叙利亚就有一百五十万来自伊拉克的难民。

en: and while I was there, I went inside and met with some internally displaced people.
zh: 而在那期间，我还到境内走访，会见了一些境内流离失所者。

en: You know, these are the people made homeless because of the war.
zh: 这些人因为战争而失去了家园。

en: They are refugees and this trip is to get a better picture of the internally displaced people
zh: 他们是难民；这次访问是为了更全面地了解境内流离失所者的情况，

en: and to discuss the situation with the local government, with our government, with the NGOs and with local people and try to understand what is happening,
zh: 与当地政府、我国政府、非政府组织以及当地民众讨论现状，努力弄清楚正在发生什么。

en: because there are over 2 million internally displaced people and there doesn’t seem to be a real coherent plan to help them
zh: 因为境内流离失所者超过两百万人，但似乎还没有一个真正协调一致的援助计划。

en: and there’s lots of good will and lots of discussion — but just a lot of talk at the moment and a lot of pieces need to be put together.
zh: 虽然有很多善意，也有很多讨论，但目前还多停留在口头上，许多环节仍需要整合。

en: So, trying to figure out what they are.
zh: 所以，我想弄清楚具体需要整合哪些环节。

en: What kind of a sense have you been able to get so far in terms of how severe the crisis is and what actually needs to be done to help out?
zh: 到目前为止，对于危机有多严重，以及具体需要做些什么来提供帮助，您了解到什么情况？

en: Well, I in my research before I came here, I looked at the numbers and there are over 4 million people displaced and of the 2 million internally displaced
zh: 来之前做调查时，我看了相关数字：流离失所的人超过四百万；而在其中两百万境内流离失所者中，

en: it’s estimated that 58 percent are under 12 years old.
zh: 估计有百分之五十八是十二岁以下的儿童。

en: So it’s a very high number of people in a very, very vulnerable situation and a lot of young kids.
zh: 所以，处境极其脆弱的人数非常多，其中还有很多年幼的孩子。

en: So far the different officials I’ve met with and different local people I’ve met with all have shared concerns
zh: 到目前为止，我会见的不同官员和当地民众都有共同的担忧，

en: and very strongly, you know, they have spoken out about the humanitarian crisis but um, there seems to be a block in.
zh: 也都强烈呼吁关注这场人道主义危机；但是，事情似乎卡在了某个环节。

en: I’m not good at policy and fixing all this and saying what’s wrong.
zh: 我不擅长政策，也不擅长解决这一切，或指出问题究竟出在哪里。

en: But I do know that for example U.N.H.C.R. needs to be more active inside Iraq.
zh: 但我确实知道，例如联合国难民署就需要在伊拉克境内更积极地开展工作。

en: How do you think U.N.H.C.R. should be doing?
zh: 您认为联合国难民署应该怎样开展工作？

en: Well, I don’t have the answers but I know that this is one thing that needs to be addressed and solved
zh: 我没有现成的答案，但我知道这是必须处理和解决的问题之一，

en: because there does need to be a real presence here to help count the people and register the people.
zh: 因为这里确实需要有机构实实在在地开展工作，帮助统计人数，并为这些人登记。

en: This is the end of part one of the interview.
zh: 访谈的第一部分到此结束。

en: Questions one to five are based on what you have just heard.
zh: 第1至5题根据你刚才听到的内容提问。

en: Question 1. What is the main purpose of Angelina’s visit to Iraq?
zh: 安吉丽娜访问伊拉克的主要目的是什么？

en: Question 2. How many internally displaced people are there in Syria?
zh: 叙利亚有多少境内流离失所者？

en: Question 3. What do we learn about the current crisis in Iraq?
zh: 关于伊拉克当前的危机，我们了解到什么？

en: Question 4. What do we learn about Angelina from the interview?
zh: 从采访中，我们对安吉丽娜有了什么了解？

en: Question 5. What do we learn about U.N.H.C.R.?
zh: 关于联合国难民署，我们了解到什么？
